title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether an Urban Sub-district Office Shall Independently Bear Civil Liability

articles.content_en:
Sichuan Higher People's Court:
Your Request for Instructions on Whether the Urban Sub-district Office May Independently Bear Civil Liability (No. 117 [1996] of Sichuan High Court) has been received. Upon deliberation, the reply is as follows:
Where an enterprise established by a sub-district office has legal person status, the sub-district office shall bear civil liability only within the scope of the management fees it collects; where the enterprise established by it does not have legal person status, the enterprise shall first bear the corresponding civil liability, and the insufficient portion shall be independently borne by the sub-district office within the scope of the registered capital of the enterprise. When the property of the sub-district office is insufficient to bear the liability, the city or district people's government which established the sub-district office shall not bear civil liability. Where disputes arise from the sub-district office's own civil activities, it shall independently bear civil liability.
This is our reply.
